dct_title_s: Chart showing population trends for the city of Minneapolis, Minnesota comparing federal census data of 1930 and 1940 by census tracts; disclosing areas of population volume stabilization -- increase and decrease
dct_alternative_sm: Chart showing population trends for the city of Minneapolis, Minnesota comparing federal census data of 1930 and 1940 by census tracts; disclosing areas of population volume stabilization -- increase and decrease
dct_description_sm: Map shows wards, census tracts, parks, boulevards, cemeteries, railroads, water areas, and municipal airport.; Census tracts are shaded in coded textures and marked with percentages to indicate growth, decrease, and no change (meaning less than 2% growth or decrease) between 1930 and 1940.; "Chart No. 4."; "1400 / 3-24."--Marked in pencil at upper right and lower left corners of map recto and verso.; Black ink on ecru paper surface.; Pasteovers and erasures appear white on map surface. Some ink has faded and discolored.
